text: THIRTY-ONE DESIGN-SYSTEM DEFECTS FROM THE DBIM AND WCAG AUDIT OF 30 SEP 2026. Control edges: sixteen controls drew their only boundary at 1.66:1 (WCAG 1.4.11) — Checkbox, Radio, selection cards, Toggle's off track, OTP boxes, NumberInput, TimePicker, TimeSlot, Search, InlineEdit, Chip, SignaturePad, the upload drop zones, CommentThread, FeedbackWidget and the Pagination jump field — now `border/neutral/bolder/default` (4.6–6.3:1); placeholders 4.48 → 5.96:1. Focus: Button's success and danger rings 2:1 → 6.7:1; the NavSheet's expanded row had an invisible ring in every brand; A+/A− at their limit and InlineEdit while saving no longer throw focus to the page. Names (2.5.3): the language button, FileList's Try Again and the SAMAVESH banner's toggle now contain their visible words. Behaviour: Tooltip can be hovered (1.4.13); error and warning Toasts persist and the rest pause on hover and focus (2.2.1), on the toast rung of the layer ladder; Escape in a Popover, Tooltip or the chat no longer also closes the Modal behind it; Lightbox without a caption is named; SideSheet no longer sits 16px off a phone screen; Modal, SideSheet and FormPanel footers wrap; the Wizard reserves its phone bar's measured height so a focused field is never under it; ErrorView's default Try Again reloads. Fixes: GeoPhotoInput printed a code comment inside its add tile; Aadhaar and PAN inputs drew no error state; DatePicker's `invalid` drew nothing; the chart data table printed as a 1px box; BulkActionsBar re-read every button on each count. DBIM green: Tooltip ink 1.39 → 14.5:1, Stepper tick 2.35 → 8.6:1, DatePicker selected day, NavSheet row and SitePageHeader text 4.32 → 4.67:1. A missing icon font no longer spills the icon's name across its control.
